host_report.source: README.md at 53e388f19707620ad24ce215b3862da7c07c9c47, Method, validation and reproduction
host_report.note: These are the contemporaneous report fields, not a newly queried host snapshot. No separate machine-readable host capture was retained for these phases.

clocks.read_elapsed: R proc.time elapsed delta around one read, after full GC; excludes process startup and signature computation
clocks.process_wall: Historical time.time delta around the spawned process, including startup and teardown; distinct from read elapsed
clocks.peak_rss: wait4 ru_maxrss for the full child lifetime; macOS bytes, divided by 1e9 for decimal GB
clocks.cache: Contemporaneous report states filesystem caches were warm; no cold-cache claim

correctness.qualification_order: Not recorded. The historical runner did not enforce qualification before timing.
correctness.screen_and_tuning: Timed dimensions are recorded. Complete separate signature records for every screen/tuning variant are not retained.
correctness.bindings: The historical report states input/library/worker hashes matched before and after each phase. Original binding.json snapshots are exported here. Separate after snapshots were not retained; the final runner checks equality before writing its summary.

screen.runner_binding: Runner and plan were not included in this phase binding; their historical exact bytes cannot be verified from it.

tuning.runner_binding: Runner and plan were not included in this phase binding; their historical exact bytes cannot be verified from it.

final.runner_binding: Runner and plan are included in this phase binding.
